headline: Your motion and design-system work is the job. The one gap is how a product behaves while a model is thinking.

gaps.name: AI UX patterns
gaps.why: Recipe Genie shows only rotating loading text and a retry-less error toast, so your AI states are thinner than your motion work.

evidence.text: Only rotating loading text and a retry-less error toast
motion-kit: spring physics, 212 stars, 4.2 KB gzipped
Owns Kite UI: 42 components, 3 squads, Storybook

moves.title: Add AI states to Kite UI
moves.body: Give the design system you own the components an AI product needs: thinking, streaming, partial and failed.

have.text: You own Kite UI: 42 components across 3 squads

phases.title: Name the states
tasks: List the states a generated answer passes through, from your own two apps
Sketch each one in Figma with the motion it needs
phases.deliverable: A one-page spec of AI states

phases.title: Build four components
tasks: A thinking indicator, a streaming text block, a partial-result card and a failed-call toast with a retry
Stories for each, with reduced motion covered

phases.title: Prove them in a product
tasks: Drop them into Recipe Genie in place of the loading text and the toast
Record a short clip of each state
phases.deliverable: A clip and a Storybook link you can put on your resume
